home.trapSubtitle: Five trap bosses — beat them to truly level up!
home.trap1Symptom: The question is too vague, so the AI can’t tell what you want — of course the answer’s off!
home.trap1Solve: Give the AI clear context, needs, constraints and the output format you expect!
home.trap2Symptom: Blindly copy-pasting others’ prompts and using them without understanding how they work!
home.trap2Solve: Understand the structure and logic first, then adjust to your needs!
home.trap3Symptom: Asking for too much at once — too complex for the AI to nail perfectly in one shot!
home.trap3Solve: Break the problem down, go step by step, and refine gradually!
home.trap4Symptom: Believing everything without thinking, easily misled by wrong info!
home.trap4Solve: Verify sources, cross-check, and keep your skepticism and judgment!
home.trap5Symptom: Copying content without understanding it, so you learn nothing!
home.trap5Solve: Understand first, then output it — make it your own knowledge!

learn.petSubtitle: Pick a buddy to study with you. It walks around the front-end with you and jumps up when you finish a lesson. PR 1 default: walking + reaction events; later upgrades add AI chat and proactive heartbeat interactions.
learn.toggleWalkHelp: When off, the pet stays in a fixed spot
learn.toggleProactiveHelp: When on, the pet occasionally reaches out to chat while you are idle (once every 15 min)
learn.aiModelDefault: System default (Claude Haiku 4.5 — fast and cheap)
learn.aiModelNote: Choosing a different model changes the pet's response style / speed / cost. Haiku is the cheap default; Sonnet has more character; GPT has a different style.
learn.customPromptLabel: Custom personality prompt (for the AI — controls how the pet talks)
learn.customPromptPlaceholder:
e.g. You are a cocky Siamese cat who thinks it is the coolest, talks down to everyone but is actually very clingy.

(Leave blank = use our default template: species-based clinginess / sass / short lines)
learn.toggleByokLabel: Use my own AI API key
learn.byokHelpOn: On — uses the key you set in /settings/ai-keys and does not count against the system quota
learn.byokHelpOff: Off — uses the platform shared quota (10 free per day)
learn.byokTip: 💡 Set no AI customization and the pet uses the platform defaults (Haiku model + built-in personality template + shared quota). Want more character? Pick another model and write your own prompt; want unlimited chat? Connect your own key.
learn.petEvolveSubtitle: Spend Z-coin to level up your pet, change its look, and unlock more abilities.
